correctness.rationale: Positive-definite body mobility M gives positive Schur complement S=A-cc^T/m. Itô applied to F(theta)=-R(theta)Jc/m cancels the correlated W0 noise and yields each independent reset-cycle displacement Y=F(theta_tau)-F(0)+M_tau, with M conditionally centered. Angular first and second harmonics produce the exact centered covariance, its traceless part 2 beta h(u)(S0-gamma(u) H) and trace 2 beta tr(S)+||c||^2(1-e^-2u)/(m^2 tau). For c!=0, gamma=2m/(1+e^{2u}) bijectively decreases from m to 0, giving isotropy iff S0=alpha H with 0<alpha<m, unique tau* and perpendicular-to-parallel principal-axis swap. c=0 is correctly separated, near/far limits and positive definiteness hold. Independent numerical covariance, reset threshold and axis tests passed; the infinite-horizon assertion follows from independent cycles, not samples.
